title.zh: SmartLingo 课程教室迁移 SmartMeeting V2
title.en: SmartMeeting V2 interactions in SmartLingo course rooms

purpose.zh: 将已验证的 SmartMeeting V2 成员在线、私密支持聊天、媒体等待及录音附件体验完整适配至 SmartLingo 课程教室。
purpose.en: Adapt the reviewed SmartMeeting V2 member presence, private support chat, media waiting, and recording and attachment interactions to SmartLingo course rooms.

zh: 所有课程教室只允许登录会员进入；同一会员只保留一个在线设备或标签页，在线人数包含自己；群组音频显示成员出入提示条。
单排操作栏、等待中的橙色扬声器、直播成员提及、主持团队定向回复的七天私密支持聊天及可滚动消息列表。
一个人等待第二位会员时不连接 RealtimeKit；媒体轨道状态与操作同步，独处和静音时按宽限期收尾。
课程录音及附件侧栏提供本地 15 分钟录音、30 分钟音频文件试听上传和仅本机播放的文字朗读；保留原有课程录制资料。
en: Require a signed-in member in every course room; limit each member to one online device or tab, include self in presence, and show arrivals and departures in group audio.
Use a one-row action bar, orange waiting speaker, streaming-member mentions, seven-day private support chat with addressed host-team replies, and a scrollable message list.
Wait for a second distinct member before joining RealtimeKit, reconcile actual media tracks with controls, and close lone or idle connections after grace periods.
Add local 15-minute recording, 30-minute audio-file preview and upload, local-only text-to-speech, and attachment drawers while retaining existing course capture records.

zh: 课程教室页面、成员在线及加入接口、私密聊天、录音和附件接口、D1 课程表；不改变学习内容、课程购买、Max 价格或支付流程。
en: Course-room page, presence and join APIs, private chat, recording and attachment APIs, and course D1 tables; learning content, course checkout, Max pricing, and payments are unchanged.

zh: 新增在线租约、定向聊天接收人和课程音频笔记的追加式迁移；音频文件存放 SmartLingo 自己的私有 R2，使用现有配额及延迟清理。
en: Add an additive migration for online leases, chat recipients, and course audio notes; audio remains in SmartLingo's own private R2 under existing quota and durable cleanup rules.

zh: D1 首次及重复迁移、在线租约与私聊隔离测试、媒体回归、TypeScript、零警告 lint、全站测试、构建、敏感信息扫描和发布门禁；部署后核验站点和 Project 记录。
en: Fresh and repeated D1 migrations, presence and private-chat isolation tests, media regressions, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, full-site tests, build, sensitive scan, and release gates; verify production and Project record after deployment.

zh: 按用户先前指示，本次跨站迁移不对每个目标重复四人实时媒体浏览器演练；生产端检查课程教室入口与基础页面可用性。
en: Per the owner's earlier instruction, this cross-site migration does not repeat the four-participant live-media browser exercise on every target; production verification covers course-room entry and basic availability.

zh: SmartLingo 使用课程教室和 Free/Max 会员术语，并保留课程播放列表和既有课程录制；以站点自己的 D1、R2、Clerk 和 RealtimeKit 资源实现同一交互契约。
en: SmartLingo uses course-room and Free/Max terminology and keeps its playlist and existing course capture; the interaction contract uses only this site's D1, R2, Clerk, and RealtimeKit resources.

rollback.zh: 应用迁移后结构保持追加式；若需回退应用，重新部署上一成功提交并保留新增表与列及已写入数据。
rollback.en: The applied schema remains additive. To roll back the app, redeploy the previous successful commit while retaining new tables, columns, and written data.
